decision.summary: A multi-axis offset begins at index 490 (N/E up ~1–2 MAD, U up ~0.5 MAD). The interior (490–514) is sustained and coherent across axes. A potential return initiates in U around 515, but no clear opposing return is observed in N or E within allowed context [455,555]; thus the interval remains uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported in the allowed context.

intervals.observation: N and E show a sustained upward shift from index 490; U shows a smaller concurrent offset. Return not yet observed in N/E by 514, and U exhibits only a possible early opposing trend starting ~515 but not confirmed as full recovery.
